label: No Man's Sky sandboxes
description: How No Man's Sky sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: mo2.

notes: The MODS folder is created on first deploy. The game only reads mods when GAMEDATA/SETTINGS/GCMODSETTINGS.MXML lists them, and a stale list is the usual reason a mod does nothing.
Saves are in AppData/Roaming/HelloGames/NMS, outside the install.
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.

presets.label: Clean
presets.description: Nothing deployed - the vanilla game, for checking whether a bug is yours.

options.label: Additional launch arguments
options.description: Passed verbatim. One argument per space; nothing here goes through a shell.
